LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 USE OF INTERROGATIVES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how much more..., when/who/why/what else with peers for example, who else attended the ceremony?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify interrogatives: how, what, when, why, who in sentences correctly
2. use interrogatives how much more..., when/who/why/what else accurately in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 USE OF INTERROGATIVES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify interrogatives: how, what, when, why, who in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use interrogatives how much more..., when/who/why/what else accurately in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how much more..., when/who/why/what else with peers for example, who else attended the ceremony?
2. how much more sugar was bought?
3. Why do we ask questions?
4. How do we ask questions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify interrogatives: how, what, when, why, who in sentences correctly
2. use interrogatives how much more..., when/who/why/what else accurately in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
